messages:
anya: quick flag 1: new int4 onboard (harbor-lite-int4) is showing an odd class of funcall parse failures in streaming/ndjson workloads. fail rate ~1.8% vs 0.6% baseline.
marco: what kind of failures? truncated json, invalid commas, or extra keys?
lina: mostly trailing fragments and dangling commas when we stream arrays. example from stream: `[{\"action\":\"upsert\",\"params\":{\"k\":1}}, {\"action\":\"noop\",\"params\":{}} ,` 1: the trailing comma breaks our NDJSON/JSONL parser.
zane: int4 quant sometimes emits shorter tokens that cut mid-utf8/escape, so we see partial tokens too: `{"action":"route","params":{"id":"abc\"` then EOF.
oliver: another confounder: retry behavior. our client retried on parse error, but retries sometimes hit a different instance mirror with different KV cache prefix -> the model continues with a different context leading to different suffixes. makes it look nondeterministic.
anya: thanks. proposal: three-pronged approach: 1) pre-parse streaming sanitizer that heuristically strips trailing commas and common JS-style comments/suffixes for CANARY/QA only; 2) add request-id provenance so retries keep being routed to same mirror when feasible; 3) instrument sample-storage: persist raw failed chunks (1% sample) to bandwidth S3.
marco: +1 on sanitizer for QA, but we should avoid auto-mending in prod. also add a parser-mode header (strict|lenient) so callers decide.
lina: I'll draft a small sanitizer that runs before the JSONL parser: steps = strip JS comments (/*...*/ and //...), trim trailing commas in arrays/objects if they match a regex, and if still invalid, mark fatal. unit tests will inject mid-token truncation and trailing comma cases.
zane: routing note: we can add sticky-routing by request-id for 10s to reduce mirror mismatch for rapid retries. may increase load on single instance but should cut this signal noise.
oliver: metric ideas: toolcall.parse_error.{truncated, trailing_comma, unknown_top_key}, plus routing.retry_swapped boolean tag. create a short-lived dashboard to watch on int4 canary.
anya: deploy plan: soft-sanitizer + sticky routing + sampling -> rollout to QA cluster only. if parse_error.rate drops to baseline without bumping latency we can run an A/B on production traffic where clients opt-in via header.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/sanitize-stream-qa -> qa cluster @ 2026-03-21T11:00Z :rocket:
marco: I'll run a 12h A/B on QA: lenient vs strict. collecting parse-error breakdown, retry counts, avg latency, and percentage of sanitized outputs.
lina: adding unit tests now into repo: tests/stream_sanitizer_test.py with cases for trailing comma, comment suffix, and mid-token truncation.
zane: small security caveat: sanitizer must not swallow top-level unknown keys that could be malicious. whitelist only `meta`/`metadata` as safe to preserve; all other unknown top keys remain errors. log raw output for review.
anya: ok let's proceed. keep production strict unless downstream explicitly opts-in. post back results here tomorrow.
marco: noted, will upload A/B delta to the eng-ml dashboard and paste link here. :thumbsup:
